critical_code_review_comments: Modals.jsx Tutorial Hints Choice reuses CFG_SOUND options array (line ~257) which happens to be [{value:'on',label:'On'},{value:'off',label:'Off'}]. Works today, but coupling two unrelated settings to the same options constant is fragile — a future change to CFG_SOUND (e.g., adding 'auto') would silently break the tutorial toggle. Recommend a dedicated CFG_TUTORIAL const identical in shape.

TutorialOverlay useState({}) 'seen' state is per-mount. If the parent unmounts/remounts TutorialOverlay for any reason (theme change, StrictMode double-mount in dev, phase transitions that toggle rendering), the tour would reset unexpectedly. Consider lifting 'seen' state to reducer or useRef guarded by a session key.
Modals.jsx still exceeds 900 lines (carry-over). Splitting into per-modal files remains recommended.

RenegeNotice 8s auto-dismiss timeout is fine, but if user dismisses via button, timeout still fires against a stale onDismiss closure — currently harmless (parent setter is idempotent) but could hide bugs if the callback becomes non-idempotent.
